# Brnos Aires

> Přehledně a aktuálně o argentinském tangu v Brně. Community hub for Argentine tango in Brno, Czech Republic — events calendar, classes, milongas, articles, and people profiles.

## Key Pages

- [Calendar](https://brnosaires.com/tango-kalendar-brno/): Upcoming milongas, workshops, practicas, and classes from all local organizers
- [Classes](https://brnosaires.com/tango-lekce-brno/): Regular class schedules from all tango schools in Brno
- [Milongas](https://brnosaires.com/tango-milongy-brno/): Upcoming milongas in Brno
- [About](https://brnosaires.com/o-nas/): About Brnos Aires, the people behind it, and iCal subscription links

## Events

- [Tango Weekend](https://brnosaires.com/jarni-tango-vikend-v-brne/): Brnos Aires Tango víkend — 3-day event (22–24 May 2026) with workshops, live music milonga, and instructors from Vienna
- [Tango Marathon](https://brnosaires.com/marathon/): Annual tango marathon in Brno (16–18 Oct 2026) — 200 m² wooden floor, ~150 experienced dancers, healthy schedule, closed embrace

## Optional

- [Tidbits](https://brnosaires.com/tango-pikosky/): Articles about tango history, music, and culture (pikošky)
- [Announcements](https://brnosaires.com/lenka-pise-oznamy/): Community news and updates
